**<span style="color:#FF2400">T</span>hought <span style="color:#FF2400">E</span>xchange at <span style="color:#FF2400">A</span>MOR/e** (TEA) Talks aim to connect PhD students with frontier researchers from academia and industry.
Each month, AMOR/e Lab brings together an academic and an industry researcher to share their work on a frontier topic.
Sessions are held both on the TU/e campus and online, and are open to everyone interested.


```{python}
import yaml
from html import escape
from datetime import date, datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from IPython.display import display, HTML

AMSTERDAM = ZoneInfo("Europe/Amsterdam")
SPEAKER_TYPES = {"academic": "Academia", "industry": "Industry"}

def tba(text):
    # Placeholder for details that are not confirmed yet
    return f"<span class='tea-tba'>{text}</span>"

def button(url, text, icon, style="btn-outline-dark"):
    return f"""<a class="btn {style} btn-sm" href="{url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
        <i class="bi {icon}" role='img' aria-label='{text}'></i>
        {text}
    </a>"""

def as_date(value):
    return value if isinstance(value, date) else datetime.strptime(str(value), "%Y-%m-%d").date()

def time_range(session):
    # "16:00-17:30" -> ("16:00", "17:30")
    start, _, end = str(session.get("time", "")).replace("–", "-").partition("-")
    return start.strip(), end.strip()

def time_str(session):
    start, end = time_range(session)
    if not start:
        return tba("Time to be announced")
    tz = datetime.combine(session["date"], datetime.strptime(start, "%H:%M").time(), AMSTERDAM).tzname()
    return f"{start}&ndash;{end} {tz}" if end else f"{start} {tz}"

def make_speaker(speaker):
    name = speaker["name"]
    kind = speaker.get("type", "academic")
    profile = f"<a class='tea-profile' href='{speaker['profile']}' target='_blank'>Profile <i class='bi bi-arrow-up-right'></i></a>" if speaker.get("profile") else ""
    talk = f"<div class='tea-talk'><span class='tea-talk-label'>Talk</span>{speaker.get('talk') or tba('Title to be announced')}</div>"
    slides = button(speaker["slides"], "Slides", "bi-file-earmark-slides") if speaker.get("slides") else ""
    return f"""
    <div class="tea-speaker">
        <div class="tea-speaker-top">
            <span class="tea-kind tea-{kind}">{SPEAKER_TYPES.get(kind, kind)}</span>
            {profile}
        </div>
        <div class="tea-speaker-name">{name}</div>
        <div class="tea-affiliation">{speaker.get('affiliation', '')}</div>
        {talk}{slides}
    </div>"""

def make_session(key, session, number, is_past):
    day = session["date"]
    meta = [f"<li><i class='bi bi-clock'></i> {time_str(session)}</li>"]
    meta.append(f"<li><i class='bi bi-geo-alt'></i> {session.get('location') or tba('Location to be announced')}</li>")
    if session.get("online"):
        meta.append("<li><i class='bi bi-camera-video'></i> Online</li>")

    upcoming_buttons = []
    if session.get("register"):
        upcoming_buttons.append(button(session["register"], "Register", "bi-pencil-square", "tea-btn-primary"))
    else:
        upcoming_buttons.append("<span class='btn btn-sm tea-btn-soon'><i class='bi bi-hourglass-split'></i> Registration opens soon</span>")
    past_buttons = []
    if session.get("recording"):
        past_buttons.append(button(session["recording"], "Recording", "bi-play-btn"))

    topic = session.get("topic") or tba("Topic to be announced")
    poster = f"<img class='tea-poster' src='{session['poster']}' alt='Poster: {escape(session.get('topic', ''))}'>" if session.get("poster") else ""
    description = f"<p class='tea-description'>{session['description']}</p>" if session.get("description") else ""
    speakers = "".join(make_speaker(s) for s in session.get("speakers", []))
    return f"""
    <article class="tea-session{' tea-past' if is_past else ''}" id="{key}" data-date="{day.isoformat()}">
        <div class="tea-session-head">
            <div class="tea-datebox">
                <span>{day.strftime('%b')}</span><b>{day.day}</b><span>{day.year}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="tea-head-text">
                <a class="tea-number" href="#{key}">TEA Talk #{number}</a>
                <span class="tea-status">{'Past' if is_past else 'Upcoming'}</span>
                <div class="tea-topic">{topic}</div>
                <ul class="tea-meta">{''.join(meta)}</ul>
            </div>
            <div class="tea-actions tea-upcoming-only">{' '.join(upcoming_buttons)}</div>
            <div class="tea-actions tea-past-only">{' '.join(past_buttons)}</div>
        </div>
        {poster}{description}
        <div class="tea-speakers">{speakers}</div>
    </article>"""


sessions = yaml.safe_load(open("teatalks.yml")) or {}
for session in sessions.values():
    session["date"] = as_date(session["date"])

chronological = sorted(sessions, key=lambda k: sessions[k]["date"])
numbers = {key: i + 1 for i, key in enumerate(chronological)}
today = date.today()
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
display(HTML(
    "<div class='tea-sessions'>"
    + "".join(make_session(k, sessions[k], numbers[k], sessions[k]["date"] < today) for k in reversed(chronological))
    + "</div>"
    + """
<script>
// The site is only rebuilt on push, so mark sessions whose date has passed as past on page load.
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
    const now = new Date();
    document.querySelectorAll(".tea-session:not(.tea-past)").forEach(session => {
        if (new Date(session.dataset.date + "T23:59:59") < now) {
            session.classList.add("tea-past");
            session.querySelector(".tea-status").textContent = "Past";
        }
    });
});
</script>"""
))
```
